summary: Lock in hydration, shut out damage. A deeply restorative conditioner that smooths the hair shaft and neutralizes static.
description: Structural smoothing for the hair fiber. This formula utilizes positively charged conditioning agents to bind to negatively charged damaged areas of the hair, instantly flattening the cuticle and reflecting light.
technical_overview: Offered at $24.0 for 250ml, this KoColor CONDITIONER is expertly formulated with Cetearyl Alcohol, Behentrimonium Chloride, and Argan Oil. It delivers a high-fidelity Soft White color profile (`#FAF0E6`) and leverages cationic charge bonding.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Apply from mid-lengths to ends after shampooing. Leave for 3 minutes before rinsing with cool water.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: The cool water rinse is critical; it scientifically forces the cuticle to contract and seal, amplifying the gloss effect.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Behentrimonium chloride acts as the primary anti-static and detangling agent, offering superior slip without silicone buildup.
